title: oes512-residual: OES-512 reference implementation and seed-42 synthetic benchmark (16 × OES-32 residual blocks)
description:
OES-512 = 16 × OES-32 residual blocks: a reference implementation of the OES-512 layout, 512 channels arranged as 16 blocks of 32, each block scored with the weighted latch S = 0.45·Peak + 0.35·RMS + 0.20·MeanAbs on the absolute residual, latched at τ = 0.50. Includes a seed-42 synthetic benchmark (Stable, Noisy, Localized Burst, Global Shock; 1,000 trials each), a pytest suite, and a self-contained browser avatar.

Added in 0.3.0: educational demo. sparky-oes512-demo.html is a separate, self-contained bilingual (English / Canadian French) page with the Sparky avatar. It scores synthetic scenarios or a loaded 512-value CSV against a built-in synthetic reference band, shows blocks with missing channels as a separate “missing data” state rather than as anomalies, and displays an experimental, not validated parity-asymmetry signal (A = |mean(r)| / (mean|r| + ε)) that does not trigger alerts by default. It uses the same block formula and default τ = 0.50 as the reference, but it is an educational demo, not the normative reference. A Node self-test (tests/sparky-demo.test.mjs) runs in CI. Not a medical device; SYNTHETIC data only.

New in 0.5.0: Sparky, the empathetic AI beaver (uploadable personalities). Talk to Sparky in the demo page (version 0.5.0) can load a personality: a small, strictly validated JSON file (64 KB maximum, known fields only, text only, https-only brand link) that sets the assistant’s name, brand line, greeting and farewell, tone, formality (tu/vous in French, casual/formal in English), empathy openers, light catchphrases and speech rate, pitch and voice hints. The default persona is Sparky, the empathetic AI beaver for Fredericton Holograms: warm, patient and honest, opening with “I hear you.” / « Ça se comprend. » when someone sounds worried or alerts are on screen. A personality only changes the wording: the medical-safety reply, every number and every alert or missing-data fact are locked in code, catchphrases never appear on safety or alert replies, and files with reassuring phrases such as “don’t worry” are rejected. An optional aiBrain block is stored but never used; the page still makes no network calls. Documented in docs/PERSONALITY.md with the example personalities/sparky-empathetic-beaver.json; a new Node self-test (tests/sparky-personality.test.mjs) runs in CI. The scoring core is unchanged. Teaching demo, not a medical device; human review required for every alert.

0.4.1 is a packaging fix with the same code and demo as 0.4.0; it supersedes v0.4.0, whose archive accidentally included unrelated third-party package files.

New in 0.4.0: Talk to Sparky. The demo page (version 0.4.0) adds a bilingual voice and text assistant. Push-to-talk questions use the browser’s Web Speech API (en-CA / fr-CA); a text box works in every browser. Replies are spoken with the browser’s speech synthesis while the beaver avatar animates, and are shown in a conversation log. Answers come from an offline, rule-based brain that quotes the analysis on screen (status, per-block scores, score formula and threshold, syndrome, missing data, parity meter, limits) and can switch scenario or language by voice; medical questions always get the same answer: a teaching demo, not a medical device, with human review required. The page makes no network calls itself; in some browsers (for example Chrome) the browser’s own speech recognition may send audio to the browser vendor’s servers. The scoring core is unchanged. New Node self-tests (tests/sparky-brain.test.mjs, tests/sparky-smoke.mjs) run in CI.

Evidence tags. OES-512 block layout (16 × 32 channels): implemented as a reference. Weighted latch, τ = 0.50: implemented as a reference. Seed-42 benchmark: SYNTHETIC. Operational, field, flight or medical performance: UNRUN (not claimed).

Relationship to ADR-001. The normative per-block residual is defined in oes32-residual@b77b612.

Scope and limits. The four Gaussian regimes are far apart, so perfect synthetic scores show that they are easy to separate, not that the method is operational. Not hardware, a field product, a medical device or clinical protocol, or a commercial product; not a quantum or QPU system.

Evidence tags follow sparkainlp-x/.github (SYNTHETIC / REPORTED / TARGET / UNRUN).
